messages:
Anna (Product): Quick sync: we must finalize Private deploy scope for next release. Key areas: packaging format, upgrade handoff, and customer-managed networking. Need clear owners.
Mike (Eng): Can we separate 'operator-managed' vs 'customer-handshake'? Want to know MVP constraints.
Jess (Field Eng): Customers repeatedly ask for opt-out of automatic upgrade and IP retention guarantees. Also want a documented rollback path.
Ravi (NetOps): Suggest two supported workflows: 'managed' where Redwood coordinates upgrades, and 'handshake' where customer confirms upgrade window. For MVP ship handshake first.
Anna (Product): Agreed. MVP = handshake workflow + assisted operator tooling. Full managed automation deferred.
Olga (Customer Success): We'll need a customer-facing rollback playbook and comm templates. Also a one-pager explaining tradeoffs (downtime risk, IP preservation).
Mike (Eng): Packaging approach: single artifact + manifest.json. Add CLI: `redwood-upgrade --handshake=manual|auto --manifest=path`.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: build 2023.11.7 - smoke OK :white_check_mark:
Jess (Field Eng): IP preservation detail: if customer uses hostNetwork or static routing, we can preserve node IPs. For cloud-managed nodes IPs may change; document both paths.
Ravi (NetOps): Handshake protocol: customer provides token, ASN, and peering IP ranges. We run CIDR overlap and ASN checks before proceeding.
Mike (Eng): Upgrade sequence: preflight checks -> snapshot KV/cache -> drain/cordon optional -> run upgrade -> post-healthchecks -> rollback if failure. Rollback uses snapshot restore and config revert.
Anna (Product): Decision: include snapshot+rollback + handshake in MVP. Defer managed auto-upgrade to Q3 roadmap.
Olga (Customer Success): Action: CS to draft rollback playbook, customer comm templates, and a launch checklist for NetOps owners.
Jess (Field Eng): I'll line up three pilot customers for handshake testing: ACME, PilotHealth, LedgerOps.
Mike (Eng): Manifest fields proposal: "upgrade.handoff.mode", "upgrade.handoff.token_location", "upgrade.handoff.preserve_ips" (true/false). Keep backward compatibility.
Ravi (NetOps): Legal must approve peering/IP retention terms. I'll open ticket to Legal + Security.
Anna (Product): Owners & deadlines: CS/Field draft -> 2026-04-10, Eng implementation -> 2026-04-17, Docs -> 2026-04-20. Weekly sync until pilots complete.
Olga (Customer Success): Starting draft now and will loop in Pilot owners.
Mike (Eng): Installer preflight to include: disk, KMS access, CIDR overlap, handshake token presence.
Anna (Product): If no objections by EOD Friday we'll freeze scope. Thanks all.
